goal.en: Plays a selected easy piece by Gurlitt with a left-hand accompaniment pattern, hands together.
goal.tr: Gurlitt'ten seçilmiş, sol el eşlik kalıplı kolay bir parçayı eller birlikte çalar.

explanation.en: Cornelius Gurlitt (1820–1901) wrote many short teaching pieces. They are in the public domain.
explanation.tr: Cornelius Gurlitt (1820–1901) çok sayıda kısa öğretim parçası yazdı. Bu parçalar kamu malıdır.

explanation.en: Many of them put a broken-chord or Alberti pattern in the left hand under a simple melody. You know these patterns from this module.
explanation.tr: Birçoğu basit bir melodinin altında sol ele kırık akor ya da Alberti kalıbı verir. Bu kalıpları bu modülden tanıyorsun.

explanation.en: Before you play, find the pattern: name the chord of each bar and the left-hand shape it uses.
explanation.tr: Çalmadan önce kalıbı bul: her ölçünün akorunu ve sol elin kullandığı şekli söyle.

explanation.en: Learn each hand alone, then put them together slowly. Keep the accompaniment softer than the melody.
explanation.tr: Her eli ayrı öğren, sonra yavaşça birleştir. Eşliği melodiden yumuşak tut.

explanation.en: The microphone result for notes that start together is experimental and does not block your progress. With a MIDI keyboard the result is exact.
explanation.tr: Birlikte başlayan notalar için mikrofon sonucu deneyseldir ve ilerlemeni engellemez. MIDI klavyeyle sonuç kesindir.

brief.en: The selected piece from the public-domain score, at the marked tempo and at a slow tempo, piano synthesis.
brief.tr: Seçilen parça, kamu malı notadan, yazılı tempoda ve yavaş tempoda, piyano sentezi.

task.en: Play the left hand alone through the piece with the click. Then play hands together slowly, and finally at the marked tempo.
task.tr: Parça boyunca önce yalnız sol eli klikle çal. Sonra eller birlikte yavaş çal, en sonunda yazılı tempoda.

selfCheck.en: I named the chord of each bar before I played.
selfCheck.tr: Çalmadan önce her ölçünün akorunu söyledim.

selfCheck.en: The melody was louder than the accompaniment.
I did not speed up or slow down.
My line matched the reference at the slow tempo.

fix.en: The left hand stops when the right hand gets busy. Play the left hand alone with the click until it runs by itself.
fix.tr: Sağ el yoğunlaşınca sol el duruyor. Sol el kendiliğinden akana kadar onu klikle tek başına çal.

fix.en: The accompaniment is too soft for the microphone. Keep it lighter than the melody, but take every key to the bottom.
fix.tr: Eşlik mikrofon için fazla yumuşak. Onu melodiden hafif tut ama her tuşu dibine kadar indir.

adaptation.en: Play the melody with only the first note of each left-hand group, then add the full pattern.
adaptation.tr: Melodiyi sol elin her grubunun yalnız ilk notasıyla çal, sonra kalıbın tamamını ekle.

repertoire: Cornelius Gurlitt (1820–1901), an easy teaching piece with a left-hand broken-chord or Alberti accompaniment (selection pending; opus and number to be confirmed from a 19th-century edition). Public domain, legal review pending. Needs transcription from a PD source. Notation, fingering and tempo by Ostinato. Search status 2026-11-02: the PD scans reachable without CAPTCHA (archive.org mirrors of Op. 74, Augener ca. 1886; Op. 101, Schirmer 1895; Op. 130, Augener 1910) were checked. Their first pieces put chords or the tune in the left hand rather than a steady broken-chord or Alberti pattern, so no piece is selected yet; Gurlitt's broken-chord teaching pieces (e.g. Op. 117, Op. 187) still need a pre-1930 scan.
